thread:
Ava: Heads up — we discovered a set of year-end trial bundle credits that were invoiced as prepaid but shipped over multiple months. Need guidance on deferral vs. immediate recognition, and who signs off for the manual accrual. Spreadsheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcDEF-trial-bundle-recon
Ravi: Can you summarize the amounts and timing? rough numbers are fine — we'll need to understand the pattern for the rev schedule.
Ava: Total $78,400. 3 customers, contracts started Oct/Nov, services delivered through Jan. Billing treated as prepaid in Oct. We think revenue should be recognized over service period (3 months) not upfront.
Tom: Sales confirms these were sold as 3-month trial bundles with usage-based addons. Contract language is ambiguous about upfront vs. monthly recognition.
Priya: If service is delivered over time, deferral is appropriate. We need a formal journal and a sign-off from controller for the manual adjustment. Also need to classify as deferred revenue with a revenue schedule in the system.
Maria: GL impact: move prepaid revenue (4000-Prepaid) -> 3000-DeferredRevenue (liability) then amortize to 4001-Revenue monthly. Will post reversal entries following your schedule.
Ava: Proposed JE (one-time posting):
```
Dr 4000-PrepaidRevenue 78,400
Cr 3000-DeferredRevenue 78,400
```
Then monthly amortization starting Nov 30:
```
Dr 3000-DeferredRevenue 26,133.33
Cr 4001-SubscriptionRevenue 26,133.33
```
Ravi: Looks right. Please include the customer list and supporting evidence in the ticket. Also confirm whether any of the amounts fall under promotional credits requiring separate disclosure.
Ava: Two of the three were promos tied to a pricing experiment (Q4 promotional code), total promo value $12,000. We think the promo portion should reduce recognized revenue over the same schedule.
Priya: Agree. Treatment: record deferral net of promo (i.e., defer gross invoice then present promo as contra-revenue on amortization). Document decision in the close memo. I'll approve once the memo and the spreadsheet have the breakdown per customer and the journal preview.
Ava: Added per-customer rows and attached contract snippets in the sheet. Tagging ticket FIN-4872 with link.
LedgerBot: Journal FIN-4872 draft submitted by Ava for review (status: pending).
Tom: Sales to confirm that none of these customers have termination clauses that would change recognition (i.e., refundable vs. non-refundable).
Ava: Confirmed — trial bundle non-refundable once activated, termination only stops future months.
Priya: OK — I sign off on the deferral approach. Ava, please route the JE to Maria for posting and attach the controller approval in Coupa/CloseDocs.
Maria: Will post JE tomorrow in the afternoon after review. Please assign GL codes on each line of the spreadsheet (done).
Ava: Thanks all — I'll update FIN-4872 and close the loop after posting. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: Nice, make sure this is included in the month-end close checklist and the revrec memo for audit.
Ava: Will do.
